WITH filtered_d AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE (d_moy = 4 AND d_year = 1999) OR (d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d_year = 1999)
),
store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        ss_item_sk, 
        s_store_sk, 
        MAX(ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit
    FROM 
        store_sales
    JOIN 
        filtered_d ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    GROUP BY 
        ss_item_sk, 
        s_store_sk
),
store_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        sr_item_sk, 
        sr_returned_date_sk, 
        MAX(sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss
    FROM 
        store_returns
    JOIN 
        filtered_d ON sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    GROUP BY 
        sr_item_sk, 
        sr_returned_date_sk
),
catalog_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        cs_item_sk, 
        cs_sold_date_sk, 
        MAX(cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
    FROM 
        catalog_sales
    JOIN 
        filtered_d ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    GROUP BY 
        cs_item_sk, 
        cs_sold_date_sk
)
SELECT 
    i_item_id, 
    i_item_desc, 
    s_store_id, 
    s_store_name, 
    COALESCE(store_sales_profit, 0) AS store_sales_profit, 
    COALESCE(store_returns_loss, 0) AS store_returns_loss, 
    COALESCE(catalog_sales_profit, 0) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM 
    item
JOIN 
    store ON i_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND s_store_sk = ss_store_sk
LEFT JOIN 
    store_sales_agg ON i_item_sk = store_sales_agg.ss_item_sk AND s_store_sk = store_sales_agg.s_store_sk
LEFT JOIN 
    store_returns_agg ON i_item_sk = store_returns_agg.sr_item_sk AND store_returns_agg.sr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN d_date_sk AND d_date_sk + INTERVAL 6 MONTH
LEFT JOIN 
    catalog_sales_agg ON i_item_sk = catalog_sales_agg.cs_item_sk AND catalog_sales_agg.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN d_date_sk AND d_date_sk + INTERVAL 6 MONTH
WHERE 
    (d_moy = 4 AND d_year = 1999) OR (d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d_year = 1999)
GROUP BY 
    i_item_id, 
    i_item_desc, 
    s_store_id, 
    s_store_name
ORDER BY 
    i_item_id, 
    i_item_desc, 
    s_store_id, 
    s_store_name
LIMIT 100
